what: Imported 9-skill workflow set (goals/mock/requirements/architecture/plan/execute/fix-bug) + config template
statedReason: A set of Claude Code skills for structured feature development ... All skills reference a central workflow-config.md template with placeholders for project-specific paths, commands, test conventions, and related skills.

what: Bind the task file path to the dequeued TODO entry instead of an unbound $TASK_FILE
statedReason: implement_task.md referenced $TASK_FILE with no binding.

what: Explicit folder-creation step before writing exploration notes into it
statedReason: write-implementation-plan step 4 wrote _exploration_notes.md into implementation_plan/ before that folder existed

what: Unify requirements.md shape: REQ-<CAT>-<N> ids, MUST/SHOULD/MAY, Out of Scope, acceptance table
statedReason: extract-requirements-from-mock and write-requirements produced incompatible requirements.md formats, but write-architecture consumes either one and assumes a single shape.

what: README section listing which skills need a human vs. are unattended-safe
statedReason: The README pitches overnight autonomous coding, but several skills hard-block on user confirmation

what: Machine-readable tasks: YAML in 00_overview.md as the executor's source of truth
statedReason: execute-implementation-plan parsed the human-readable Task Index table to build its TODO list, which made the executor brittle to any drift in table formatting.

anchor: CRITICAL: Triage failures before fixing them
what: Replace 'no pre-existing failures' with base-branch triage and a blocker exit
statedReason: implement_task.md previously declared "ALL failures are your responsibility" with no escape hatch, which caused scope creep on long autonomous runs (the agent would chase unrelated, pre-existing bugs).

what: Move workflow-config.md out of .claude/skills/ and repoint 9 files
statedReason: .claude/skills/ is conventionally for skill folders only, but the workflow-config template lived alongside them as a stray file.

what: Quality slots accept a list of commands, run in order, stop at first failure
statedReason: Real projects often have multi-step quality pipelines (build -> lint -> test, sometimes per package).

what: UI code root slot so mocks can read the real UI
statedReason: none

what: Standardize argument-hint syntax across all skills
statedReason: none

what: Handle an empty conversation history
statedReason: none

what: Drop multi-step and single-command examples and the UI_CODE_ROOT example (23 lines)
statedReason: Drop the multi-step-pipeline and single-command examples from Quality commands; the bulleted slot definitions are self-explanatory.

what: Optional Backlog section read verbatim by /next when nothing is in flight
statedReason: The /next skill reads this section to fetch pending work from an external tracker (Todoist, Linear, Jira, a markdown file, etc.) when no feature is in progress.

what: Interactive /setup-workflow that fills the config's placeholders
statedReason: Walks the user through .claude/workflow-config.md and replaces <PLACEHOLDER> values interactively.

what: /next orchestrator: proceed/explain/description modes, stage detection by artifact presence, .next-current pointer
statedReason: The single entry point to start or continue feature work. Reads .claude/workflow-config.md, finds or selects the active feature, and either runs or just describes the next slash command in the workflow.

what: Bootstrap the project config from ~/.claude/workflow-config.template.md
statedReason: When the per-project workflow-config.md is missing, the skill now tells users to copy from ~/.claude/workflow-config.template.md (deployed alongside the global skills) instead of pointing them back to the workflow-skills repo.

what: /update-workflows copies the repo's skills to ~/.claude/
statedReason: Provides a one-step way to redeploy this repo's workflow skills and workflow-config template to ~/.claude/, so changes made here propagate to every project on the machine without manual cp commands.

what: Shared interaction file: normal/expert verbosity, 1-3 questions per turn, numbered questions + lettered options
statedReason: Introduces .claude/skills/_shared/interaction.md as a single source of truth for how workflow skills should talk to the user: terse-vs-verbose mode, small-chunk question pacing, and a numbered-question / lettered-option format that lets the user reply with compact answers like "1a,2c".

anchor: ## Stopping rules / Plan vs. skill precedence
what: Every task ends green; explicit stopping rules; task notes never beat safety rules; batched clarifying questions
statedReason: Three connected changes so /write-implementation-plan and /execute-implementation-plan run longer without stopping for user input

what: Every question turn ends with a Recommend: line the user can accept in one reply
statedReason: Skills end each question turn with a "Recommend: ..." line so the user can accept the model's read in one reply.

what: Move hardcoded Python-style rules out of implement_task.md into an optional config section
statedReason: These are project/language conventions, not workflow rules, so they violated the "skills agnostic, project specifics in workflow-config" split.

what: Revert c4835cd's triage escape hatch; all failures are the agent's again
statedReason: The triage escape hatch let the agent declare too many failures as pre-existing, undermining the autonomous-run safety net.

what: Compression pass: 13-line stopping rules -> one paragraph; 32 lines cut across 4 skills
statedReason: Surgical pass over files that existed on main: keep every correctness fix and every new capability, but drop prose that didn't earn its weight.

what: Revert step 4 verification wording to main's
statedReason: none

what: A failing command in a list means fix-and-retry, not terminate
statedReason: Clarify list-of-commands semantics: fix-and-retry, not terminate

what: Drop the acceptance-criteria table from the mock-extraction path
statedReason: Drop redundant Acceptance Criteria from extract-requirements-from-mock

what: Replace 'press enter to skip' with chat-friendly phrasing
statedReason: none

what: Revert the machine-readable tasks: YAML block added 19 days earlier
statedReason: none

what: Nine skills collapse into one user-invoked skill with stages/, references/ and a TS state engine
statedReason: Plugin restructure: the old .claude/skills/* set becomes a single user-invoked skill (skills/next) with stages/, references/, and a TypeScript state engine

what: 476-line TS state engine, two commands, approval hashes and a downstream-clearing cascade
statedReason: State engine redesign - two commands (report, approve), three ideas

what: Task completion is a file move into implementation_plan/done/; tasks_done/set/reopen deleted
statedReason: Task completion lives in the filesystem: finished task files move to implementation_plan/done/, scoped to one approved plan version ... tasks_done, set, reopen, and the stale-task gate are gone.

anchor: route rides on the goals approval
what: approve goals route=<full|direct|bugfix> makes an unrouted goals approval unrepresentable
statedReason: The route rides on the goals approval (approve goals route=...), so a goals approval without a route is unrepresentable; route_lost and the approve-mock side effect are gone.

what: Broken/missing state file is an error naming the user's options; salvage tier deleted
statedReason: No recovery by inference: a broken or unexpectedly missing state file is an error naming the user's options ... the salvage/inference tier and orphan_task_files are gone.

what: Format/Check/Unit tests before the plan's first task only; mid-plan red is the work's to fix
statedReason: Execute stage: baseline gate scoped to the plan's first task (mid-plan red is the work's to fix, never "pre-existing")

what: A stuck implementer gets one fresh-context retry; a blocked one stops immediately
statedReason: a stuck implementer gets one fresh-context retry, a blocked one stops immediately

what: Goals(+mock) gate and acceptance pass are the only human gates; everything between self-approves
statedReason: There are exactly two **human gates**: the goals(+mock) gate at the start, and the acceptance pass at the end. Every stage in between self-approves through the critic gate below and continues in the same session - the user is never asked to approve requirements or plans.

anchor: ### The critic gate (requirements and plan stages)
what: Fresh-context critic subagent per artifact; defects -> revise; 3 rounds max then stop
statedReason: Defects -> revise and re-dispatch a fresh critic. After **3 rounds** without a pass, stop and present the artifact and the remaining defects to the user - an honest stall beats looping.

what: Stages past goals never ask; non-obvious inferences go in an Assumptions section covered by the approval hash
statedReason: Stages past the goals gate never ask clarifying questions. Infer defaults from the goals, mocks, codebase, and `.claude/mise-config.md`, and record every non-obvious inference in an **Assumptions** section

what: Per-task fresh-context reviewer, one review/fix round per task
statedReason: On success, dispatch a fresh reviewer subagent (fresh context catches what the author's context rationalizes away).

what: Acceptance subagent returns a per-requirement checklist; on confirmation the mise directory is deleted
statedReason: On the user's confirmation, clean up: delete the mise directory entirely and commit the deletion ... the artifacts served their purpose

what: Setup interviews and writes a minimal .claude/mise-config.md; reference is never copied into projects
statedReason: Instruction files trimmed so every rule has one home; setup commits the generated config; no-e2e projects get a blanket Test exception at setup.

what: The write-architecture stage is dropped: README goes from 5 mentions of architecture to 0
statedReason: none

what: Config's code-conventions section deleted; repo-wide conventions move to CLAUDE.md
statedReason: There is no code-conventions section: repo-wide conventions belong in `CLAUDE.md`, which every agent - including fresh-context subagents - loads automatically.

what: New authoring guide for the instruction files (45 lines)
statedReason: docs consolidate into README + skill-authoring guide + the engine spec (docs/state-machine.md)

what: Ban REQ-* traceability ids from comments, identifiers, test names and strings; add to self-review
statedReason: Implement-task stage now explicitly prohibits REQ-* traceability IDs in code (comments, identifiers, test names, strings) and adds them to the self-review checklist

anchor: ### The critic gate (requirements and plan stages)
what: Severity tags (blocking/minor/informative); pass = zero blocking; stall on non-decreasing blocking count + 5-round backstop
statedReason: **Pass = a report with zero blocking findings** - a fresh critic can always find _something_, so "no findings at all" is never the bar.

what: The goals critique is internal working notes, surfaced only as questions or direct edits
statedReason: The critique is working notes, never output - do not present it as a standalone review.

what: Mocks must cover empty, loading, error placement, and per-action success/failure
statedReason: A state skipped here becomes a requirements-stage assumption instead of a user decision.

what: Each mock gets a unique ID; a mental-model audit records surviving new concepts in mocks.context.md
statedReason: Audit every concept the mock introduces: genuinely new, worth its learning cost, or internals leaking into the UI? ... an unlisted concept becomes an assumption instead of a user decision.

what: Required Branch convention config value; new work creates the branch, never runs on default
statedReason: Starting new work now ensures a work branch: on the default branch it creates one from the config's new required Branch convention value; on any other branch it asks whether to reuse it. Missing convention re-fires the config gate.

what: Post-acceptance retrospective subagent proposes minimal guidance edits routed to guide/config/CLAUDE.md/new doc/plugin candidate
statedReason: After acceptance confirmation and before cleanup, a fresh-context retrospective subagent mines the run for guidance improvements and proposes minimal edits routed to their natural home

what: _friction.md: one line per friction event; only the retrospective reads it
statedReason: Raw material comes from a new friction log (_friction.md): critic gates record multi-round passes and stalls, execute records task failures, reviewer defects, and acceptance items the user flags. Only the retrospective reads it, so it costs later stages nothing.

what: Top-level opt-out line for the retrospective
statedReason: Opt out with a top-level `Retrospective: off` config line.

what: Ship step after cleanup, style recorded at setup and never assumed
statedReason: Shipping is now part of the pipeline: after the cleanup commit the close-out ships per the config's Ship value (pr | merge (<style>) | off, asked at setup; the merge style is a recorded choice, never assumed).

anchor: Never open a pull request ... any branch whose tree contains `.mise/`
what: Setup writes a CLAUDE.md guard against PR/merge of in-flight branches
statedReason: Setup also writes a CLAUDE.md guard so sessions outside the workflow refuse to PR/merge any branch whose tree still contains the mise directory.

what: Acceptance confirmation recorded as a hash so an interrupted close-out resumes at the retrospective
statedReason: report returns `close_out` while the record matches, so an interrupted close-out resumes at the retrospective instead of re-running the pass.

what: Optional Models section maps 6 subagent roles to models; unassigned roles inherit the session model
statedReason: An optional ## Models section in .claude/mise-config.md maps subagent roles (implementer, reviewer, critic, acceptance, explore, retrospective) to models ... Setup interviews for it, suggesting generation roles on opus with quality gates on the session model.

anchor: A user-visible change updates `README.md` in the same run
what: Repo rule: user-visible changes must update README in the same run
statedReason: The README is the user's only description of the config surface and the stage list, so a skill-file-only change ships an undocumented feature.

what: Version bump shipping the Models section (the feature commit did not bump)
statedReason: none

what: Count-based stall replaced by recurrence tracking: fresh/recurring classification, 3 stall triggers, 5/8 round budgets
statedReason: Points 3 and 4 ... now decide continuation by defect identity instead of blocking counts, which misfired whenever a round of all-new findings matched or exceeded the previous round's count even though every prior fix had landed.

anchor: ### The critic gate (requirements and plan stages)
what: Squash of f7656c2+1ba0b07 onto main; README stall annotation synced; version 1.7.0
statedReason: I often run into the following case. I would like to improve the system so that this does not happen. The stop seems unnecessary. [.mise/goals.md 'Original report', branch feat/critic-stall-heuristic @86b3aa0~1]

anchor: A user-visible change also bumps `version` in `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`
what: Retrospective-adopted rule: bump plugin.json version in the same run
statedReason: Claude Code installs and updates the plugin by version, so a change that ships without a bump never reaches an installed user, and no test or quality gate catches it.

what: Authoring guide rewritten: drop 'do not terse-ify', adopt the 'would removing this line cause a mistake?' test
statedReason: Rephrase for a human reader: shorter sentences, one rule per line, rationale only where a rule would otherwise be misapplied; revise `docs/skill-authoring.md` (drop "do not terse-ify", adopt the "would removing this line cause a mistake?" test). [.mise/goals.md Goal 2.5]

what: Three new config values: Checklist file (cap 15 rules), scoped Task tests command, Review notes source
statedReason: A project file of **checkable rules** ... owned by the project and registered in `.claude/mise-config.md` as a required value; the config gate blocks execution without it [.mise/goals.md Goal 1.1]

what: Interaction reference rewritten; critic gets its own self-contained role file
statedReason: Restructure by reader: orchestrator-side files (dispatcher + stages) and self-contained **role files** for every fresh-context subagent ... so prompts are no longer composed ad hoc inside `execute.md` and `interaction.md`. [.mise/goals.md Goal 2.2]

what: Self-contained implementer role file replaces stages/implement_task.md
statedReason: Restructure by reader ... self-contained **role files** for every fresh-context subagent (implementer, reviewer, critic, acceptance, documenter, retrospective) dispatched by path [.mise/goals.md Goal 2.2]

what: Reviewer and acceptance role files added
statedReason: a fresh-context reviewer must be told to flag only correctness/requirement gaps or it will always report something [.mise/goals.md, External guidance]

what: New documenter role: when configured, implementers write no prose and one end-of-plan pass writes it
statedReason: I would like to have a way to define which model writes comments. This is motivated in the fect that Opus 5 is very good at coding but horrible and anything that has to do with prose or even code comments. [.mise/goals.md Original description item 3]

what: Retrospective now treats every user correction as a checklist/doc proposal; adds the Review notes source
statedReason: The retrospective now treats every user correction as a proposal for that checklist ... so feedback you've given once becomes a rule the workflow enforces from then on. [.mise/goals.md Original description item 1]

what: execute.md rewritten as v2 orchestrator; per-task scoped verification, full quality commands moved to an end-of-plan gate
statedReason: **Per task**: implement ... -> scoped verification (format + check + the task's tests via a new optional config value `Task tests:` ...) ... **Once at the end of the plan**: documenter pass (when configured) -> full quality commands and any e2e/sanity runs -> acceptance pass [.mise/goals.md Goal 4.1-4.2]

what: Each task modifies at most 5 source files; unjustified breach is blocking for the plan critic
statedReason: Anthropic's PR-size data shows >1000-line diffs get findings 84% of the time vs 31% for <50 lines [.mise/goals.md, External guidance]; This replaces the "~2 hours of focused work" ceiling. [Goal 1.4]

what: Explain mode cut from the dispatcher (3 mentions -> 0); SKILL.md 2068 -> 1120 words
statedReason: the `?` explain mode once [used] [.mise/goals.md, Other usage facts]; Behavior cuts and keeps decided at the gate: **cut** the `?` explain mode [Goal 2.4]

what: README documents the v2 surface; plugin version 2.0.0
statedReason: Version bumps to 2.0.0; README documents every new config value, role, and stage change. [.mise/goals.md, Decisions recorded at the goals gate]

what: Skip the branch question when the current branch is new and named for the work
statedReason: correction: review notes on v2 files - ... branch question skipped for a new correctly named branch (fixed) [.mise/_friction.md @a6f5016~1]

what: A reply of `rec` accepts every recommended pick
statedReason: correction: review notes on v2 files - ... rec shortcut for recommendations (fixed) [.mise/_friction.md @a6f5016~1]

what: Reword <default> at three sites (acceptance, execute, documenter)
statedReason: correction: "<default>... never its own history" read as commit-on-main - reworded at three sites (acceptance, execute, documenter) [.mise/_friction.md @a6f5016~1]

what: Show the rec hint on every Recommend line
statedReason: correction: Recommend line should show the rec hint itself (fixed) [.mise/_friction.md @a6f5016~1]

what: Route corrections: documented-but-ignored or mechanical rules to the checklist, new conventions to docs first
statedReason: correction: checklist routing priority - documented-but-ignored or mechanical rules to the checklist, new conventions to durable docs first (fixed, option b) [.mise/_friction.md @a6f5016~1]

what: Squash: checklist, 6 role files, documenter, end-of-plan gate, Task tests, guardrail; 11267 -> 9795 words
statedReason: mise 2.0.0: project review checklist, documenter role, end-of-plan gate, halved instruction files

what: Retrospective-adopted: reviewer term in Test exceptions, Review notes section in this repo's own config
statedReason: Adopt retrospective learnings: reviewer term in Test exceptions, Review notes section

what: Checklist answers move out of the progress log into the commit body; Key changes and Deviations bounded
statedReason: `eric/attribution-3`'s `_progress.md` reached **56,330 words / 68 entries** ... **46% of it is dead weight.** Of 56,330 words, **26,172 are the `- Checklist:` bullets** (65 of them) that 2.0.0 added at `roles/implementer.md` step 6. [.mise/goals.md section A @5fabf88~1]

what: Documenter rescoped from the whole branch diff to one task's diff, dispatched before the reviewer
statedReason: `fix/menu-pin`, commit `45b0bad8c` - **61 files, 349 insertions, 100 deletions, of which 345 added and 100 removed are comment lines**. One subagent, one commit, a 61-file comment rewrite. [.mise/goals.md section B @5fabf88~1]

what: The gate no longer re-runs the documenter on a repair that touched no documented code
statedReason: `stages/execute.md` re-runs the gate from step 1 "after any commit lands past a finished gate (a repair, an acceptance-blocker fix)", and step 1 is the documenter. That is how attribution-3 accumulated six whole-branch prose passes. [.mise/goals.md section C @5fabf88~1]

what: Reviewer verifies the implementer's recorded answers instead of re-deriving all rules
statedReason: Okven's checklist is at 14 of the 15-rule cap ... All 14 are answered by the implementer (`roles/implementer.md` step 5), again by every fix implementer, and independently again by the reviewer [.mise/goals.md section E @5fabf88~1]

what: Fix the per-task prose/not-prose defect router and compress the six instruction files
statedReason: task 01_01: review found the per-task defect router's bullets overlapping (single-pass mixed lists drop prose defects) and a malformed nested code span [.mise/_friction.md @5fabf88~1]

what: Two-pass rules collapsed into one contract; acceptance's narrowed prose sweep and the documenter heading discriminator dropped
statedReason: correction: instruction files must stay concise and targeted; task 01_01 grew the six files 3793 -> 4406 words (+16%), against the branch's own purpose since every subagent reads them [.mise/_friction.md @5fabf88~1]

what: Squash onto main: per-task documenter, checklist answers in commits, verifying reviewer; skills md 9795 -> 9974 words
statedReason: Fixes the token and wall-clock regression 2.0.0 introduced, measured on two okven runs

what: Explicitly NOT changed in 2.1.0 despite both okven runs exhausting the budget
statedReason: **The critic-gate round budget** (the `4e828af` non-convergence stall). Both branches ran both artifacts to `budget exhausted`, but the user chose to leave the loop alone; it stays as-is. [.mise/goals.md 'Explicitly out of scope' @5fabf88~1]
